item.name: Abaddon
item.look: A winged seraphim in a golden veil and beige tunic, with horn-pierced eyes, a third eye on the forehead, and wings and eyes covering the body.
item.idTell: This is a female body. Siren and Keres always use a female model, so this look can belong to either type.
item.cardSummary: A winged seraphim with a golden veil. Female, so a Siren or Keres can appear as this body.

item.name: Leech
item.look: A floating nun in a black tunic, white sleeves, black veil, and cross necklace, with no legs and a wide mouth of sharp teeth.
item.idTell: This is a female body. Siren and Keres always use a female model, so this look can belong to either type.
item.warning: If the ghost is a Dullahan, the veil and hood vanish in photos with the head.
item.cardSummary: A legless nun with a leech-like mouth. Female, so a Siren or Keres can appear as this body.

item.name: Rattle
item.look: A shaking puppet in a long bluish-gray dress, with wood-like skin, glowing white eyes, and floating strings holding her up.
item.idTell: This is a female body. Siren and Keres always use a female model, so this look can belong to either type.
item.warning: Dead hunters can appear hung from the ceiling by puppet strings.
item.cardSummary: A string-held puppet in a long dress. Female, so a Siren or Keres can appear as this body.

item.name: Watcher
item.look: A horned figure in a long torn grey dress, with wrinkled flesh, eyes over the body, three distorted faces on the head, chest, and back, and grey hair to the shoulders.
item.idTell: This is a female body. Siren and Keres always use a female model, so this look can belong to either type.
item.cardSummary: A three-faced, horned body in a torn grey dress. Female, so a Siren or Keres can appear as this body.

item.name: Biter
item.look: A brown-suited figure with holes through the body, clothes, and face, plus sharp visible teeth.
item.idTell: This is a male body. It rules out Siren and Keres. Dullahan is always male and looks headless in photos.
item.warning: Turn on Trypophobia Safe Mode to replace this body with a cat image.
item.cardSummary: The hole-riddled suited mascot. Male, so it cannot be a Siren or Keres, and a Dullahan using it looks headless in photos.

item.name: Dr. Ratched
item.look: A grey-skinned doctor in a long white coat over blue scrubs and gloves, with sunken eyes and a smaller second head joined at the mouth.
item.idTell: This is a male body. It rules out Siren and Keres. Dullahan is always male and looks headless in photos.
item.cardSummary: A two-headed doctor in a white coat. Male, so it cannot be a Siren or Keres, and a Dullahan using it looks headless in photos.

item.name: Marrow
item.look: A stitched pink-fleshed figure in a blue shirt, brown apron, and black pants, with knives on the arms, metal bars warping the face, and extra pupils.
item.idTell: This is a male body. It rules out Siren and Keres. Dullahan is always male and looks headless in photos.
item.cardSummary: A stitched, apron-wearing body with knives and extra pupils. Male, so it cannot be a Siren or Keres, and a Dullahan using it looks headless in photos.

item.name: Mouthpiece
item.look: A black-suited figure with cracked shell-like skin, black gloves, a bowtie, and a head that can detach from the body except for the lower jaw.
item.idTell: This is a male body. It rules out Siren and Keres. Dullahan is always male and looks headless in photos.
item.warning: The Mouthpiece Dullahan skin is a cosmetic. It is not the Dullahan ghost type, which looks headless in photos.
item.cardSummary: A suited body with a detachable head. Male, so it cannot be a Siren or Keres. Do not mix its Dullahan skin up with the Dullahan type.
